findings.evidence: grep in BasedPath.lean: the only occurrences of `BasedPath.initialSegmentFamily`/`γ.initialSegmentFamily` are its own defining lines 251–280; every use site (509, 288) is `Path.initialSegmentFamily`. grep across ./code finds no other reference.
findings.fix: Delete the `BasedPath.initialSegmentFamily` block (def + five lemmas). If a later roadmap stage genuinely needs it, reintroduce it then, non-`@[expose]` and only as needed.
findings.issue: `@[expose] public def BasedPath.initialSegmentFamily` and its lemmas `initialSegmentFamily_zero`, `initialSegmentFamily_one`, `toPath_initialSegmentFamily`, `endpoint_initialSegmentFamily`, `continuous_initialSegmentFamily` (lines 251–280) are dead: no consumer references them. `append`/`continuous_append_initialSegmentFamily`/`joinedIn_preimage_of_append` all use `Path.initialSegmentFamily δ` directly (lines 288, 293, 509). This is unused public surface, including an unnecessary `@[expose]` on the def and five dead `@[simp]` lemmas added to the global simp set.

findings.evidence: All call sites of these declarations are within BasedPath.lean (grep lines 288/293/375/510); no downstream module references them.

findings.issue: `Path.truncateOfLE_range_subset_preimage` (line 200), `Path.initialSegmentFamily` + `continuous_initialSegmentFamily_uncurry` + `initialSegmentFamily_apply/zero/one` (lines 216–240), and `BasedPath.continuous_append_initialSegmentFamily` (line 286) are `public` but consumed only inside this file (lines 288, 293, 375, 510). summary: The entire BasedPath.initialSegmentFamily wrapper and its five lemmas are exposed (one @[expose] def plus public/@[simp] lemmas) but never used — the real machinery uses Path.initialSegmentFamily throughout. Several Path/continuity scaffolding lemmas are also public despite being used only inside this file.
